profile.headline: Senior Software Developer | Team Leadership | Building Scalable Web Applications
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a proven track record in application design, web-based applications, and front-end development. Completed a Master of Science in Computer Science from California State University, Los Angeles, with over 8 years of hands-on experience in Software Development.

Proficient in a range of programming languages and frameworks including ReactJS, AngularJS, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Laravel, Node.js, and SQL/NoSQL. Skilled in analyzing, reviewing, and understanding business and testing requirements, with expertise in creating comprehensive test plans, strategies, and scripts.

Sound knowledge of all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), as well as SCRUM and Agile methodologies.

A collaborative team player with strong leadership skills, adept at driving projects forward while fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. Passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex challenges and deliver innovative solutions.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
• Supervised an overseas team of 6 contractors, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality
deliverables; conducted comprehensive code reviews, implementing best practices to enhance code
quality and performance.
• Integrated with multiple Management Systems; potential earnings of 1 million dollars of additional
profit within 6 months.
• Redesigned the web application (Bridge) to improve user experience, leading to a user base increase
of 40% within a year.
• Collaborated with 2 different development teams on designs, feature improvements, code testing, and deployments for 12+ projects.
• Wrote front-end code, and back-end code, integrated with 6+ APIs, and utilized multiple CLI tools and
configuration GUIs.
• Resolved over 250 critical software bugs and maintained performance to ensure ongoing operations.
• Designed and optimized database schemas, ensuring efficient data storage resulting in a 20%
decrease in page load time.

projects.title: MyFilm Application
projects.description: This is a Single Page application to show the use of AngularJS functionalities. Developed using HTML5, CSS3, AngularJS, JavaScript, jQuery etc.

projects.title: Music Station
projects.description:
This application is for purchasing guitars and different music instruments online. I specifically developed this application to demonstrate the use of AngularJS functionalities like ng-route, services, directives, filters etc. I'm fetching the data from JSON file using AJAX call and displaying the data to user. User can select instruments of his choice and fill the information on next page. When the information is complete, user can proceed to buy the instrument.

Technologies used are: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, AngularJS, jQuery, AJAX, JavaScript.
